Language Learning

One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.
